title: Budapest Bank's AI Call Analysis Was Found to Have Violated Callers' and Employees' Privacy Rights in Hungary
summary: Hungary's data-protection authority found Budapest Bank's AI analysis of recorded customer-service calls violated callers' and employees' privacy rights. The system analyzed emotions and helped select callbacks and assess staff without a lawful basis or adequate notice and objection safeguards. The authority ordered an end to emotion analysis and imposed a HUF 250 million fine.
